answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. To claim one work slot, an agent burns a 150 POA deposit; the slot lives 20 epochs and the deposit is gone, like a plume of smoke. A fake wanting 100 slots must burn 15,000 POA up front, while slot earnings stay capped, so the delta between cost and gain stays negative for attackers. An honest agent pays once, keeps its ivory-stamped slot, earns steadily; a detected duplicate loses its slot unpaid.
